name: Eileen Laubacher

summary.text: Eileen Laubacher is a retired U.S. Navy rear admiral who served in the Navy from 1990 to 2024, including as Senior Defense Official and Defense Attache in New Delhi, India, and as Senior Director for South Asia on the National Security Council.
She is a 1990 graduate of the U.S. Naval Academy and lives in Highlands Ranch, Colorado, with her husband and five children.
She is the Democratic nominee for Colorado's 4th Congressional District, challenging incumbent Lauren Boebert.

experience.text: U.S. Navy, 1990-2024, retiring as a rear admiral.
Senior Defense Official and Defense Attache, New Delhi, India, 2019-2022.
Senior Director for South Asia, National Security Council, under President Biden.

research_notes: No explicit statement on abortion or gun laws was found despite checking her Ballotpedia page, campaign website (About and Platform pages), and the Colorado Politics voter-guide questionnaire; those two statements were left unsourced rather than inferred from her 'keep government out of your personal healthcare decisions' line, which is in a cost-of-care context and does not clearly address abortion. No endorsements were found on a fetched page (Ballotpedia lists only unverified 'Sway voting group' listings, which were not used). She has never held elected office, so the record field is empty per protocol. She is a former Republican who left the party before registering as a Democrat (reported by Colorado Politics/Axios), noted here for context but not used to code any position.
